<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918130_theRebbe_126" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918130_theRebbe_126__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the revelation of the Resurrection of the Dead will be of the Essence of Ein Sof, transcending divisions, and will reveal the superior intrinsic merit of Israel above even the revelation drawn through Torah and mitzvos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">However,</t>
    <t s="2">even the revelation of the days of Mashiach is only a revelation of the Surrounding [light],</t>
    <t s="3">and therefore there will be distinctions of levels within it</t>
    <t s="4">(as above),</t>
    <t s="5">but the revelation of the Resurrection of the Dead will be</t>
    <t s="6">(in its generality)</t>
    <t s="7">equal for all of Israel,</t>
    <t s="8">because in the Resurrection of the Dead there will be a revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above division.</t>
    <t s="9">And within this itself there will be two matters.</t>
    <t s="10">The revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that they drew down through the fulfillment of the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="11">and through this Israel will ascend to a higher level,</t>
    <t s="12">that the virtue of Israel themselves will be revealed,</t>
    <t s="13">"the shoot of My planting, the work of My hands, in which to take pride,"</t>
    <t s="14">for this virtue in Israel is loftier than that which draws down a revelation of G-dliness through the study of Torah and the fulfillment of mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="15">For the root of the souls is in His Essence, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="16">(above the root of Torah and mitzvos),</t>
    <t s="17">and even in the body of Israel there is the choice of the Essence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the revelation of the Resurrection of the Dead will be of the Essence of Ein Sof, transcending divisions, and will reveal the superior intrinsic merit of Israel above even the revelation drawn through Torah and mitzvos.

translations.translation: even the revelation of the days of Mashiach is only a revelation of the Surrounding [light],
and therefore there will be distinctions of levels within it
but the revelation of the Resurrection of the Dead will be
because in the Resurrection of the Dead there will be a revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above division.
And within this itself there will be two matters.
The revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof that they drew down through the fulfillment of the mitzvos,
and through this Israel will ascend to a higher level,
that the virtue of Israel themselves will be revealed,
"the shoot of My planting, the work of My hands, in which to take pride,"
for this virtue in Israel is loftier than that which draws down a revelation of G-dliness through the study of Torah and the fulfillment of mitzvos.
For the root of the souls is in His Essence, blessed be He,
(above the root of Torah and mitzvos),
and even in the body of Israel there is the choice of the Essence.
